description: This file implements shared channel invitation handling in Mattermost, including sending invites, receiving invites, creating channels (direct, group, or shared), and managing remote cluster communication.

classes.name: channelInviteMsg
classes.description: Represents an invitation message for sharing a channel with a remote cluster, including channel details and participants.

methods.name: DirectParticipantsMap
methods.description: Returns a map of user IDs to user objects for direct participants.

methods.name: SendChannelInvite
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a channel invite to a remote cluster, handling online/offline states and updating remote channel records.

methods.name: onReceiveChannelInvite
methods.description: Handles incoming remote cluster messages for channel invites, creating or restoring channels and updating shared channel records.

methods.name: combineErrors
methods.description: Combines an error object and a string message into a single error string.

methods.name: handleChannelCreation
methods.description: Creates a new local channel to represent a remote channel based on invite details, supporting direct, group, and shared channels.

methods.name: getOrCreateUser
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID or creates it if missing, using invite participant data.

methods.name: createDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates or fetches an existing direct message channel between two users based on invite data.

methods.name: createGroupChannel
methods.description: Creates or fetches an existing group message channel based on invite data.
